justifications.r1: Reliable 2-CMC rock ramp and equipment cost reducers (Danitha, Puresteel Paladin, Forge Anew).
justifications.r2: Equipment-driven card draw (Puresteel, Sram, Esper Sentinel, Akiri) generates steady cards per turn.
justifications.a1: Equipment tutors (Stoneforge Mystic, Open the Armory, Fighter Class) provide direct access to key tools.
justifications.a2: Equips and assembles voltron package on Turns 5–6.
justifications.p1: Presents lethal commander damage / shield throw threat on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p2: Requires 2 opponent untap cycles to eliminate all three players via combat.
justifications.p3: Telegraphed equipment board state; vulnerable to artifact wipes if protection isn't up.
justifications.i1: Efficient instant-speed removal suite (Swords to Plowshares, Path to Exile, Wear // Tear).
justifications.i2: Zero proactive restriction or stax effects.
justifications.s1: High-density equipment ward/hexproof (Swiftfoot Boots, Mithril Coat, Robe of Stars, Teferi's Protection).
justifications.s2: Moderate recovery via equipment recursion (Sun Titan, Mantle of the Ancients).
justifications.s3: Deck heavily relies on Captain America to throw equipment; fair voltron beatdown without him.
